\caption{The validation gate ties the best robust baseline on most of the fifteen candidate rows; against tuned tree ensembles it wins on all four insurance rows in trimmed error, but without trimming it ranges from $-$5.8 to +2.3\,\% there, and it loses on nine of the other eleven rows. Each cell is the median over splits of the paired relative difference, \(100(\mathrm{TRMSE}_{\text{gate}}/\mathrm{TRMSE}_{\text{comparator}}-1)\), in \%, with the number of splits on which the gate is better; negative means the gate is better. Gate and robust baseline are averaged over three tournament seeds. Robust baseline: the robust method (LSE, ridge-LSE, Huber, LAD) with the lowest median error on that row. RMSE columns: the same statistic without trimming. Tree: random forest (RF), ExtraTrees (ET) or histogram gradient boosting (HGB), whichever has the lowest median error after inner-CV tuning on each outer training set. Bold: at least 2\,\% better and better on at least 70\,\% of at least ten splits.}
